column1: # Partition table for running ASCII Aquarium as a guest app under
# Per the launcher's own "Critical constraint: partitions.csv must match" -
# this must be byte-identical to the launcher's partitions.csv. Copied from
# that repo and offsets pinned explicitly (rather than left blank for
# auto-alignment) to remove any risk of PlatformIO's and ESP-IDF's copies of
# gen_esp32part.py disagreeing on the auto-aligned result - these exact
# offsets were confirmed by actually building the launcher (idf.py build
# esp32s3 target) and printing its generated partition table.
# ASCII Aquarium itself only ever occupies app_slot1 in this scheme - the
# flashed from its own repo (see scripts/build_launcher_guest.sh).
